sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_notifications (tenantId,userId,workflowId,notificationType,title,message,status,channel,createdDate) SELECT gc.tenantId,utr.userId,gc.workflowId,'contract_issued',CONCAT('Contract issued: ',gc.contractName),CONCAT(:actor,' issued version ',gc.contractVersionNumber,'.'),'unread','in_app',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tbl_generated_contracts gc INNER JOIN tbl_user_tenant_roles utr ON utr.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') WHERE gc.id=:contractId AND gc.tenantId=:tenantId AND gc.status='issued' AND utr.userId<>:issuerUserId
